title: Position
description: One player's position+facing at an instant, in game-world Unreal units (uu). FUTURE for real data (Layer-B authorized source only) / POPULATED for synthetic. The legacy minimapUnits frame is removed (v2).

frame.description: Coordinate frame tag. v2 uses 'game-world-uu' (canonical); 'minimapUnits' is the deprecated v1 frame, accepted for backward compatibility. Absent is treated as legacy minimapUnits.

zoneId.description: Ascent navgraph zone id, when known.

alive.description: Whether the player was alive at this snapshot.
